svg.title: $ ping duongthaitan
svg.desc: A realistic Earth turning with clouds, a night side, an aurora and a glowing atmosphere, Soc Trang, Vietnam marked. The sun shines in the corner with a lens flare; a satellite and a space station circle the planet and a Starlink train crosses the sky. Beside it, ping duongthaitan gets a reply from each link: github.com/duongthaitan, linkedin.com/in/duongthaitan, @thaitan.duong_.
